Name: Improved Shop Inventory
Author: digarw
Description:
This mod is inspired from boringvlln's "Realistic Seasonal Shop Inventory" mods. However, instead solely rely on randomizer, I go to different approach on improving shops to be reasonably more varied and more realistic while doesn't make the game either too easy or difficult.

[heading]Key Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]All shops have restricted items stock as opposed of vanilla game where most items is unlimited;[/*]
[*]Pierre's shop, Marnie's Ranch, and Willy' fish shop are now selling actual grocery products. They are more expensive though. It's much better to getting your own than buying from them;[/*]
[*]Several items in certain shops are seasonal;[/*]
[*]Some items also rotational and have a chance to appear;[/*]
[*]Certain clothes are available for sale in some shop. Mostly related to shop owner profession. For example: Willy selling fishing vest or Marnie selling overalls. Pierre's shop have a lot of choices.[/*]
[*]Footwears also available at Pierre (and blacksmith for combat and dark boot) instead of being sold only in adventurer's guild. However, Leather boot, Tundra boot, and Firewalker boot are still only available in the guild;[/*]
[*]You can also buy a book at certain shop. Though, they don't always appear and priced at flat 10,000G. Only skill book will appear except Book Of Stars and Queen Of Sauce Cookbook.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Pierre's General Store[/heading]
This shop is now actually become general store than being just seed and farm shop. Like previously mentioned, you can buy grocery veggies and fruits here. Pierre sometime also have forages in his shelf. However, most of them are seasonal. There are few exception though, Pierre sometimes have long shelf product like parsnip or potato on off-season but they are really expensive.

For the seed, there are not much change except you now can find carrot, summer squash, and broccoli in their respective season. Strawberry seed also available starting at year 2. In mean time, Pierre also have selling some clothes, pants, and boots. He does not have many variety, but they are suitable for everyday task.

[heading]Gus Saloon[/heading]
Gus loves cooking so he often try cook as much variety as he can. Half of his meal are seasonal, but some of them always available all-season like a simple fried egg. Just check out his saloon occasionally to see how much he can go. Additionally, Gus also serves drinks like coffee, tea, and variety of alcohol in his saloon.

[heading]Clint's Blacksmith[/heading]
Instead of ores, Clint will sell you metal bars and they will be more expensive starting at year 2. As his profession, he crafted several metal items like metal fences, sprinklers, and lightning rods. He sometimes have a Mining Monthly book in his shop.

Clint have his own weapons to sell. Although, his weapons is pretty basic and not as much as from adventurer's guild. But it's not limited by mines floor level so you can grab them early; as long as you have money. Clint may also offer you a service to create metal breastplate once you reaches certain mines floor. It cost 5 bars of their respective metal and some money.

[heading]Robin's Woodshop[/heading]
You now will be able to buy clay and hardwood from Robin; they also affected on second year inflation. She also sell some useful crafts such as fences, farm object, and artisan machines in her stock. She often collect Woodcutter's Weekly so try convice her to sell one to you.

Meanwhile, furniture section got major overhaul. They now are priced two times higher than vanilla game. Furniture stock also randomized based on categories and sell on certain days. However, she don't sell any furniture at Tuesday because she weekly exercise class at Caroline's home. Even if it's rain, she still won't sell any furniture.

See the spoiler for the stock rotation table:

[spoiler]
[table][tr][th]Day[/th]
[th]Category[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Wednesday & Saturday[/td]
[td]Seat (chair, stool); personal storage (dresser, bookcase); window; lamp; painting[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Thursday & Sunday[/td]
[td]Heavy seat (armchair, couch, bench); bed; wood log; electronic (TV, fridge, telephone); plants[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Friday & Monday[/td]
[td]Table; fireplace; rug; divider; seasonal plant;[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][/spoiler]

[heading]Willy's Fish Shop[/heading]
All of Willy's hard work is finally paying off. Now he is selling all-season and seasonal fishes in rotation. Sometimes he may caught rare fishes too (but only fish that available at the town). Alongside with that, he sell invertebrates, seaweeds, and rarely jellyfish. Bait and Bobber is his favorite book and he might have one for sale.

[heading]Marnie's Ranch[/heading]
Various livestock product like eggs, milks, and cheeses now is available on Marnie's shop. She fond of sewing farmer overalls in her spare times and often put them on sale list. Stardew Valley Almanac also may be bought here.

[heading]Adventurer's Guild[/heading]
[i]Somehow I unable to disable unlockable items that based on mine floor progression. Not sure how I should do.[/i]

In this mods, the guild sell various weapons in rotation and are grouped according to their respective tiers. For starter, you only able to buy level 1 weapons in the guild. Upon reaching floor 10 mines, you will unlock level 2-3 weapons. Then on floor 50, level 4-6 weapons unlocked. Floor 90 for level 7-9 weapons. And finally after reaching mines last floor, you will able to buy Lava Katana which is level 10 weapon. Every weapons except Lava Katana are rotated stock based on group tier respectively, so you will never see same weapon every day.

For ring items, Marlon initially have small glow ring and small magnet ring for sale. More ring will be unlocked the more you going deep to mines. However, instead of outright selling them, Marlon will offer you to craft them. Small glow ring and small magnet ring can be upgraded to regular one. Meanwhile, gem rings such as Ruby ring can be crafted by handing him the required gems and few bucks.

In the meantime, Marlon selling life elixir for adventurers though it's really limited stock. He also have several monster guts and sometimes gems he looted during his adventure. He may have Combat Quarterly book on shop so be sure to get them if you afford it.

[heading]Harvey's Clinic[/heading]
Nothing unusual. Only restricted stock applied on medical items.

[heading]Alex's Ice Cream Stand[/heading]
Alex now selling cookies baked by his grandma alongside with ice cream. Sometimes he might have fruit salad too perfect for summer.

[heading]Joja's Mart[/heading]
Joja now is a big economic threat for local shops. They now sell various grocery that almost cover entire section from veggies, fruits, livestock products, fishes, to frozen meal. Not only that, they have advantage with their logistic, so all grocery will available all year around regardless of season. Seasonal product price will not even affected during off-season. Despite that, they didn't have many variety as local shop does. Also, they quite pricier initially. Although if you buy their membership, their prices is more cheaper than local shops.

Joja's seed list is similar with Pierre's, with exception that they don't sell any tree fruit saplings.

[heading]Festival Shop[/heading]
Most of them is just limiting stock. Although, I removed Strawberry seed on Egg festival as it doesn't make sense how that plant related with the festival.

[heading]Traveling Cart[/heading]
Only adds artifact trove in sale list. It cost 7500G for one.

[heading]Oasis Shop[/heading]
Not only exotic seeds, seasonal wild seeds and coffee seeds is also available here. There are changes on vanilla rotation stock such as furniture or coconut as it now more relied on random chance than certain day sale.

[heading]Dwarf[/heading]
There is no much difference from vanilla except mega bomb have a chance to appear and Dwarf may sell geodes in his shop. It will unlocked based on how deep you reach in Mines: normal geodes at floor 20; frozen geodes at floor 60; and magma geodes at floor 100.

[heading]Krobus[/heading]
Just restricting item that have unlimited stock.

[line]

This mods requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] if you want to disable certain shops. [color=#ff0000]This mods would not compatible with other mods that also changes vanila shop item list[/color], although it works fine if that mods just adding their own item without replacing this mods item.

This is my first time making mods and I haven't fully tested this mods as my game progress kinda slow. Please let me know if you have any bug report or suggestion.
